answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/features/apps-on-devices/app-review, both dated captures require predeployment manual review for apps from Stripe P2PE users and all apps intended for Verifone. They describe automated approval for non-P2PE use on Stripe readers, DevKit-only development/testing, or re-upload of the previously reviewed and approved APK. Stripe reviews the submitted device asset version: the reviewer installs on a Terminal smart reader, follows provided instructions to assess the payment UI and approves for deployment with notification when issues are absent. Unusable instructions, payment-information risks or defects preventing review can cause rejection. Typically review is within two working days and most within five from submission; longer exceptional cases and delay or failure on incomplete information are possible, with no obligation (old raw lines 8-24, old raw lines 46-56; new raw lines 9-25, new raw lines 47-57). For all apps deployed on Stripe Terminal devices, regardless of review path, use the Terminal reader running the app to collect sensitive card and PIN information. The app must have no UI for manual entry of PINs, authentication values or payment information (old raw line 14, old raw lines 34-38; new raw line 15, new raw lines 35-39). Developers prepare self-contained instructions and use DevKit sandbox in development/testing, with a minimal live charge only if live payments are necessary (old raw lines 40-44, old raw lines 58-73; new raw lines 41-45, new raw lines 59-80). November adds an app allowlist requirement using `65.87.144.8/32–65.87.144.11/32` (new raw lines 72-76). source-stripe-terminal-apps-on-devices-app-review reflects the May review branches and guidelines but lacks the November allowlist and needs its timing, credential and live-test qualifiers corrected.
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/features/apps-on-devices/app-review, update source-stripe-terminal-apps-on-devices-app-review for the November 7 reviewer allowlist instruction `65.87.144.8/32–65.87.144.11/32`, absent in May 1's instructions-to-submission sequence (old raw lines 58-73; new raw lines 59-80). The compatible-device links move from API deploy-group reader assignment to the Dashboard upload anchor, the hyperlink for device asset version disappears while the reviewed object remains, and deploy-with-api changes case. These are navigation, with section whitespace and numbering presentational (old raw lines 8-22, old raw lines 71-78; new raw lines 9-23, new raw lines 78-85). Preserve the exact manual/automated criteria, the two-day typical and five-day most estimate with exceptional delay/no SLA, the conditional minimal live charge with 1 USD as example, and separate applicable login information versus indefinite fixed authentication code without sensitive or side-effect access (old raw lines 8-24, old raw lines 40-44, old raw lines 58-69; new raw lines 9-25, new raw lines 41-45, new raw lines 59-70).
